decision.explanation: The query '2nd Duke of Newcastle' refers to two distinct historical figures with the same title: Henry Cavendish (born 1630, D1S1) and Henry Pelham-Clinton (born 1720, D2S1). The source documents explicitly distinguish them by their full names and titles (Newcastle-upon-Tyne vs. Newcastle-under-Lyne). Since both individuals held the title '2nd Duke of Newcastle' and the sources provide specific birth years for each, both 1630 and 1720 are valid, complementary answers corresponding to different referents.
